Achaemenid province of Judah; Second Temple period.
Democracy from Cleisthenes (508/7) to Macedonian suppression.

Conqueror of Judah; conquered by Cyrus.

Small state between Jin and Chu whose survival depended on diplomacy; Zichan's state. Year range is the conventional one and is NOT established from the sources cited in this batch — the Zuozhuan gives ducal years, not a foundation or extinction date. Flagged for the lead.
Great eastern state; Yan Ying's state. From 481 (Zuozhuan, Ai 14) real power passes to the Chen (Tian) house. Year range conventional, not established from the sources cited in this batch.
Northern hegemon; Shuxiang's state. Partitioned among Han, Zhao and Wei in the fifth century. Year range conventional, not established from the sources cited in this batch.

Great southern kingdom whose rulers styled themselves king. Its capital Ying was entered by Wu in 506 (Zuozhuan, Ding 4). Year range conventional, not established from the sources cited in this batch.

South-eastern kingdom that broke Chu in 506 and was itself extinguished by Yue in 473. The end date -473 IS established here: Zuozhuan, Ai 22, 'in winter, in the eleventh month, on the day dingmao, Yue extinguished Wu' (越滅吳). The start is conventional.
Kingdom south of Wu; Goujian's state, which destroyed Wu in 473. Year range conventional, not established from the sources cited in this batch.

Dorian polis and the leading land power of Greece; Athens's opponent in the Peloponnesian War, and the power that installed the Thirty in 404. Year range conventional, not established from the sources cited in this batch. No place row: Sparta itself is not yet in places.csv.

Northern neighbour and rival of Magadha; Pasenadi's kingdom, and the setting of a large part of the Pali canon (MN 135 opens at Savatthi in Jeta's Grove, read this session). YEAR RANGE DELIBERATELY BLANK: no source read for this batch gives a foundation or an end date, and the batch will not supply a conventional one it has not read.

The league of clans, the Licchavis of Vesali foremost among them, whose assembly practice DN 16 describes at 1.4.3-1.4.15 (read this session) as the seven principles that prevent decline, and which Ajatasattu means to destroy at 1.1.3. capital_place_id names Vesali as the leading city; the Pali text does not use a word for capital. Year range blank for the same reason as POL_KOSALA.

The clan territory in which the Buddha died. DN 16 has the Mallas of Kusinara sitting together at the town hall on their own business (6.12.6) and the Mallas of Pava sending for a share of the relics (6.24.25-28), both read this session: two towns, one people. capital_place_id blank because the sources name no single seat.

Chinese name 魏. One of the three ministerial houses of Jin that divided the lands of Zhi Bo in 453 and were first ranked among the feudal lords in 403. BOTH ENDS OF THE RANGE COME FROM ONE SOURCE READ AT ITS LOCATOR, not from convention, which is what distinguishes these three rows from POL_JIN and POL_QI: Shiji 15 六國年表, read at https://ctext.org/shiji/liu-guo-nian-biao on 2026-09-20 (this session). year_min: this state's column at the line the ctext edition labels 403 reads 二十二。初為侯。, and the Chu column of the same line reads 五。魏、韓、趙始列為諸侯. year_max: this state's column at the line labelled 225 reads 三。秦虜王假 ('third year; Qin took King Jia prisoner'), the Qin column of the same line adding 王賁擊魏，得其王假，盡取其地. The column is blank from the next line on. The house itself is older than 403 and its origin was NOT established from the source read here; year_min is the date of the rank, not of the family. capital_place_id is BLANK, and the reason is not a missing coordinate — written here at r6-1b (2026-09-25) on ruling L-94(3), from the r6-3 search, and superseding the earlier sentence that said only that no capital of this state was a place row here. THE REASON: this state moved its seat INSIDE the very range this row carries — Wei's seat was Anyi and then Daliang — and capital_place_id is a single nullable FK. Filling it asserts one seat for the whole range, which is false; choosing which one to assert is exactly the quiet substitution conventions §10 forbids. The four sites are locatable, at the Qin/Han COUNTY horizon and under the county name, in CHGIS/TGAZ, all four records read 2026-09-25 at https://chgis.hudci.org/tgaz/placename/json/<id> (r6-3, re-read at r6-1b): 安邑縣 hvd_95289 (-204 to 13, 35.18027 N 111.16012 E, 今山西夏县禹王乡); 大樑縣 hvd_44393 (-225 to -138, 34.78548 N 114.34333 E, 今河南开封市); 陽翟縣 hvd_82453 (-230 to 13, 34.16249 N 113.46706 E, 今河南禹州市); 邯鄲縣 hvd_87010 (-221 to 0, 36.59348 N 114.47204 E, 今河北邯郸市). So the blank is NOT for want of a coordinate — though note that each of those records is a Qin or Han county, later than the seat this row would need, and every one of them declares "license": "CC BY-NC 4.0", which is not a conventions §6 vocabulary value (SRC_CHGIS.licence_note). What is missing is a reading, at its locator, establishing WHICH SEAT HELD WHEN — Shiji 15 (SRC_SHIJI_15) is already in this corpus and already read at its locator for this row's own year_min and year_max, and its table records the Wei removal to Daliang, so it is the obvious place to establish it. That is a reading task with its own dating basis, a later round's if wanted (L-94(3)), and not something to infer here: no basis for the choice, no FK. As a matter of record, neither Anyi nor Daliang is a place row in this dataset. Added r5-3.
